profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a Miami, Florida based public company, traded under the ticker HUT, that describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. Per its own site, the company presents its portfolio as providing direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining.

The site also states that Hut 8 has fully commercialized its 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, bringing campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion.

The company's record lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile records a Florida law exposure count of 96.
